title: Camargo Fellowship 2027-28
description: Residential fellowship for artists, scholars, and thinkers at the Camargo Foundation in Cassis, on the French Mediterranean coast, for Fall 2027 (Sep 8-Nov 17, 2027) or Spring 2028 (Feb 23-May 4, 2028) sessions -- a correction to this listing's previous description, which cited the wrong session years. Scholars must focus on French, Francophone, or Mediterranean cultural studies (PhD held or near completion); artists must have at least five years of active professional practice; thinkers (e.g. curators, journalists, urban planners) critically engage with art, society, and equitable transitions. Covers a stipend of EUR 350/week (EUR 3,500 total for the 10-week residency), accommodation, some meals, and funding for basic transportation to and from Cassis. The Foundation has announced this will be the last cycle run under its current public open-call model before a new selection process begins in mid-2027.
